inventory_review: Reviewed all nine sources. Public CI fails on five non-SX1262 profiles because recorder code calls an arithmetic helper defined only inside the hardware guard.
memory_display_audio_impact: Move the existing pure bandwidth-rounding function outside the SX1262 hardware guard. No new task, heap, DMA buffer, display or audio behavior. The existing constant lookup table becomes available on every board; radio I/O stays guarded.

radios.reason: Common recording code must link even without fitted SX1262 hardware; bandwidth arithmetic and radio ownership remain unchanged.

checks: No memory allocation or radio I/O changes
